verdict.rationale: The official GitHub README states directly that Svelte is a compiler that converts declarative components into efficient JavaScript that surgically updates the DOM. The docs echo this, describing lean, tightly optimized JavaScript and components that do minimal work in the browser. Community reports corroborate it: one user stepped through readable compiled output while profiling, another praises the compile-to-imperative-JS approach, and a team reports large performance gains after migrating from React. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation explaining how compiled output performs fine-grained DOM updates, beyond high-level claims.
